subject: ONE hyena in a sweat-dark work shirt, long grin, wiry legs, bare forepaws split with thick yellow calluses, treading the great wheel on the spot, never held in one pose
second_characters: ONE vulture clerk riding the wheel rim, swinging a longer bill across the lens in EVERY beat; TWO debtors hauling crates across the lens at his shoulder in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE great wooden wheel as broad as the frame, turning under his paws in EVERY beat; from 7.40 ONE tiny wheel no taller than his knee
props.small: A SWARM of blank bill paper and grit tearing past the lens

environment: a walled payout yard packed with ledger crates and queueing debtors, top and bottom, no open sky
lighting: hard midday daylight, dust in the air, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hyena fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his grin never under a quarter of it. He treads the great wheel on the spot and it turns under him in EVERY beat, spinning the yard around him. The world flies at him: bill paper, grit, the clerk and the debtors tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat. The camera never stops, new shot size every beat, medium to very close. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word done by 4.65, then the wheel carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ra-BO-tal ne po-kla-DA-ya LAP, po-lu-CHIL TOL-ko mo-ZO-li i SCHOT

timeline.a: he slams the great wheel over with both forepaws, throwing his chest down into the stride, the clerk swinging a long bill across the lens
the clerk rides the rim unrolling a bill longer than the hyena across the lens while he shoulders the wheel round
he pounds the wheel round under him, hurling his whole body down into every stride, while two debtors cross the lens at his shoulder one after the other and bill paper tears past the lens
he rips both forepaws off the rim and thrusts them at the lens, pads up, split with thick yellow calluses, the pads filling the frame
the clerk presses a fat roll of bills into his open pads and it unrolls past his knees and past the lens
he stamps a calloused pad flat on the paper and the clerk tears the strip away over the lens
he hurls the rest of the roll past the lens while the clerk and the debtors pull away into the yard
the clerk rolls the great wheel away past the lens and swings ONE tiny wheel under him, and he drops onto it without breaking stride, his muzzle filling the frame
he treads the tiny wheel on the spot, knees slamming to his chin, the yard tearing past the lens
the clerk pins a fresh bill to the tiny wheel and it whips past the lens while he treads harder

must_appear: at 0.00 both forepaws slamming the wheel over on the spot; at 2.55 two debtors crossing the lens at his shoulder; at 4.65 both pads thrust at the lens, split with thick yellow calluses, filling the frame; at 5.30 the fat roll of bills pressed into his open pads; at 7.40 ONE tiny wheel under his paws
negative_prompt: cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, speech bubble, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a travelling camera, a conveyor belt, a cart, rails, a parked camera, a still or empty background, a wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, night, a hero back to the camera, a hero held in one pose, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 4.65, offscreen narration, English speech, a second hyena in frame
